messages.content: Give me the price of a Tesla model S in India.

function.name: get_exchange_rate
function.description: Retrieve the current exchange rate between two currencies. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

message.content:
**Tesla Model S – India (estimated)**  

| Item | Detail |
|------|--------|
| **Base U.S. price (Long‑Range)** | ≈ $90 000 (USD) |
| **Exchange rate (USD → INR)** | ~ ₹82 per $1 (current mid‑market) |
| **Converted price** | ≈ ₹7.4 million |
| **Typical Indian import duties & taxes** | 100 % import duty + 18 % GST + additional state levies (≈ 30 % of the base price) |
| **Estimated retail price in India** | **₹12–15 million** (≈ $150 k–$180 k) |

> **Why the estimate is rough**  
> • Tesla has not officially launched in India, so there is no published MSRP.  
> • Import duties on electric vehicles in India are high (≈ 100 % on the vehicle’s value).  
> • GST (18 %) and state‑specific levies add another 10–15 %.  
> • The final price would also include logistics, dealer margins, and any local incentives or subsidies that may be introduced.

**Bottom line:** If Tesla were to launch the Model S in India today, you could expect a price somewhere in the ₹12–15 million range, roughly $150 k–$180 k. However, until Tesla announces an official launch and pricing, this remains an educated estimate.
